projects.project_name: Canada Goose - Etobicoke DC & flagship retail
projects.summary: 34 cameras and 12 access-controlled doors across a distribution centre and an attached flagship retail unit. Fisheye coverage over the pick floor, domes on dock doors and the retail floor. Cabling subcontracted to a low-voltage partner; we self-performed head-end, programming and commissioning. High ceilings over the pick floor drove scissor lift requirements throughout. Retail portion required after-hours work.
projects.lessons: Mezzanine cable runs were 40% longer than estimated off the drawings. Dock door contacts needed armored loops that were not carried in the original BOM.

projects.summary: 48 cameras covering a cross-dock facility and yard, including four LPR lanes at the gate. Heavy exterior scope - pole mounts, underground conduit to the gate house, fiber to two remote poles. Access control limited to six perimeter doors.
projects.lessons: Underground bore to the gate house hit an unmarked utility. Always exclude trenching and put utility locate on the customer.

projects.summary: Access control retrofit across 38 doors in an occupied 14-storey multi-tenant tower, with 22 cameras in lobbies, elevator lobbies and loading. Existing prox credentials migrated to smart cards. Self-performed throughout. Hard-lid ceilings in the tenant corridors drove surface raceway in several areas.
projects.lessons: Reused reader wiring on 11 doors without testing it first; four runs were bad and became a change order. Test before assuming reuse.

projects.summary: New-construction plant expansion scoped entirely from drawings with no site walk. 19 cameras, 9 access doors, motion and environmental sensors in the chemical store. Issued as a provisional scope with a full assumptions block; revised twice after the building was enclosed.
projects.lessons: The provisional scope held up because the assumptions block was specific. Where it was vague - 'standard ceiling construction' - we ate the difference.

projects.summary: Templated rollout across six small-format retail stores, seven cameras and two doors each. Scoped from a prototype store walk and applied to the remaining five. Low complexity, repeatable, self-performed.
projects.lessons: Two of the six stores had different ceiling construction from the prototype. Template rollouts still need a per-site verification pass.
